name: Darkmoon (npx)
description: Drive your own self-hosted Darkmoon Pro instance, an autonomous AI penetration testing platform (open source GPL-3.0 engine and CLI): start authorized pentest runs, check run status, list campaigns and read findings. Requires your own Darkmoon Pro Dashboard API; there is no hosted endpoint.

inputs.label: Darkmoon Dashboard URL
inputs.description: Base URL of your self-hosted Darkmoon Pro Dashboard API. There is no hosted Darkmoon endpoint.

inputs.label: Dashboard Username
inputs.description: Dashboard user the server logs in as. Use a dedicated account.

inputs.label: Dashboard Password
inputs.description: Password of the dashboard user above.

obtain.instructions:
1. Open your own self-hosted Darkmoon Pro dashboard
2. Create or pick a dedicated dashboard user for the MCP server
3. Enter that user's name and password here (see the server README for details)

auth.instructions: Use the username and password of a user on your own Darkmoon Pro dashboard. The server also supports a pre-issued JWT via DARKMOON_TOKEN if you run it outside McpMux.
